history: 'Above there is heaven; below are Suzhou and Hangzhou.' When the Southern Song made Lin'an its capital, Hangzhou was among the world's most splendid cities — Marco Polo called it 'the most beautiful and magnificent city in the world'. The Ten Scenes of West Lake date from the Song; the Grand Canal's southern end is here. Bai Juyi and Su Dongpo both dredged its lake and built causeways. Today it rides the digital economy — capital of e-commerce and cloud computing, and home of Longjing tea.
importance: Capital of Zhejiang · Yangtze-delta central city · Digital economy hub
foods: Grass carp in sweet-sour sauce — the taste of a sister-in-law's farewell, the legend says.
Dongpo pork — braised slowly with little water, tender and rich.
Longjing tea leaves with river shrimp — the most elegant dish of Jiangnan.
Chicken wrapped in lotus leaf and clay, baked — crack it open for the aroma.
Noodles with pickled greens, bamboo and pork — Century-old Kuiyuan House.
Thin pancake pressed with fried dough — a folk snack honoring General Yue Fei.
Pink rice cakes stamped 'certain victory' — a send-off treat for Song armies.
Zhiweiguan's pork xiaolongbao — a century-old Hangzhou taste.
Lotus root stuffed with glutinous rice in osmanthus syrup — king of Jiangnan sweets.
Crispy fried radish-shred cakes — old street flavor of Hangzhou.
scenes: World Heritage lake — 'Spring Dawn at Su Causeway', 'Melting Snow at Broken Bridge' and more.
East-Jin temple with the Feilai Peak grotto carvings, a treasury of Buddhist art.
The sunset pagoda of the White Snake legend — one of the Ten Scenes.
1,078 islands like a fairyland — the source of Nongfu Spring water.
The world's longest canal; Gongchen Bridge watched grain ships for a millennium.
Song Culture Park — 'give us a day, we give you a thousand years'.
A wetland haven in the city — reeds and winding waterways.
The ancient tide-guarding pagoda by the Qiantang River.
Birthplace of Lion Peak Longjing tea among misty hills.
Qinghefang historic block with the century-old Hu Qingyutang pharmacy.
